## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

A two-*juan* late-Míng commentary by **Yōuxī Chuándēng** 幽溪傳燈 (1554–1628), the central figure of the late-Míng Tiāntái revival, on Huáizé's *Tiāntái chuán Fó xīnyìn jì* ([KR6d0187](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6d/KR6d0187), T1938).

**Abstract**

The composition is bracketed within Chuándēng's productive period c. 1580–1628.
